en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen sign colocation arrangement for Huanggang Port
en.dek: Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung and a Shenzhen vice-mayor signed the co-operation arrangement and right-to-use agreement, bringing the Hong Kong Port Area under HKSAR jurisdiction from midnight.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government and the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government signed a Co-operation Arrangement on the Implementation of Colocation Arrangement at the Huanggang Port on Thursday, along with an Agreement on the Right to Use the Huanggang Port Hong Kong Port Area and related extended areas.

Secretary for Security Tang Ping-keung signed the Co-operation Arrangement on behalf of the HKSAR Government with Vice Mayor Luo Huanghao of Shenzhen. Deputy Secretary for Security Joceline Chui and Director Liu Weixiang of the Shenzhen Port of Entry and Exit Office signed the right-to-use agreement. The ceremony took place at the Central Government Offices.

Under the arrangements, the Hong Kong Port Area at the redeveloped Huanggang Port will be commissioned from 00:00 hours on 31 July 2026 and will be subject to the laws of the HKSAR. The port is designed as the main 24-hour passenger land boundary control point between Hong Kong and Shenzhen. It will operate under a collaborative inspection and joint clearance mode expected to shorten average clearance time from about 30 minutes to around five minutes, with a design capacity of 200,000 passenger trips per day.

The HKSAR Government will pay a nominal annual rent of RMB 1,000 for the use of the Hong Kong Port Area. The lease runs from the commissioning date until 30 June 2047, subject to possible renewal. Shenzhen bears the design and construction costs of the redevelopment project. Officials said system testing and operational drills will follow, with the formal public opening date to be decided jointly once readiness is confirmed.

zh.headline: 港深簽署皇崗口岸「一地兩檢」合作安排
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強與深圳市副市長今日在中環政府總部簽署合作安排及使用權協議，香港口岸區將於明日零時起由特區依法管轄。
body: 香港特別行政區政府與深圳市人民政府今日（7月30日）簽署《關於在皇崗口岸實施「一地兩檢」的合作安排》，以及《皇崗口岸香港口岸區及相關延伸區域使用權協議》。
合作安排由保安局局長鄧炳強與深圳市副市長羅黃昊代表雙方簽署；使用權協議則由保安局副秘書長崔詠恩與深圳市口岸辦公室主任劉偉湘簽署。簽署儀式在中環政府總部舉行。
根據安排，重建後的皇崗口岸香港口岸區將於2026年7月31日零時起投入運作，並由香港特別行政區按照香港法律行使管轄權。該口岸將成為港深之間最主要的24小時客運陸路口岸，實施「合作查驗、一次放行」模式，預期平均通關時間由約30分鐘縮短至約5分鐘，設計客流每日20萬人次。
香港特區政府每年向深圳市支付象徵式租金人民幣1,000元。租期由口岸區啟用日起至2047年6月30日，屆時可按全國人大常委會決定續期。重建工程的設計及建造費用由深圳方面承擔。當局表示稍後將展開系統測試及演練，正式對外開放日期待雙方確認準備就緒後再公布。
